nina-sales: Hi @finance — I took an Uber to a client dinner in SF last week and my personal card was charged because the corp card declined. I don't have an itemized receipt, only the email from Uber showing $48.20 charge. Need reimbursement.

leo-finance: Hi Nina — can you upload the Uber trip email or screenshot and add the business purpose (client: NovaHealth, 1:1 demo)? Also confirm date/time and that it was for business.

nina-sales: Uploaded screenshot of the Uber email and added note: 'Client demo with NovaHealth, pickup 2026-05-14 18:12, drop-off 18:38.' Corp card decline: ash-corpcard can you see the failed auth?

ash-corpcard: Yep saw a decline at 18:10 from UBER *TRIP on the corporate card. Ramp shows it failed due to AVS mismatch. Recommend adding a quick note in Ramp and attach the Uber trip email. We reimburse posted amount in USD.

leo-finance: Okay. Expense type: "Ground Transportation" GL 6120. Please submit in Ramp, attach Uber email, and set reimbursement to $48.20. ExpenseBot: will auto-parse and flag missing mileage (n/a).

expensebot: ExpenseBot: Parsed attachment. All required fields present. Reminder: submit within 30 days.

nina-sales: Submitted. Thanks all.
